asking.note: keeper syncs and notifies about messages only while it is open. With a UnifiedPush distributor whose server is also a Matrix push gateway, your agents' approval requests and your own agent's answers reach this tablet while keeper runs in the background, read on this tablet (nothing else shows; the ids of other messages still pass through that server, and this tablet discards them); once Android has stopped keeper, a push only says that something arrived.
asking.status: keeper registers for push on this tablet only through a UnifiedPush distributor you confirm here. Installed: ntfy (io.heckel.ntfy). The one you confirm gives keeper an address on its server; keeper asks that server once whether it is a Matrix push gateway, and your homeserver then sends it the id of every message that would notify on accounts that hold agent rooms, never its words.
